sources.title: Import your fitness history
sources.intro: Start with the original export ZIP. FitFreed validates it, translates supported records into an independent local library, and leaves the source archive untouched.
sources.localOnly: The ZIP and the history built from it stay on this device. FitFreed does not upload them or ask for your provider credentials.
sources.operationProblemTitle: The source action could not be completed
sources.activeProtectedHistory: Your existing history remains unchanged until the complete import is committed.
sources.activeWorking: FitFreed is working through the archive on this device…
sources.haveArchiveBody: Choose the original archive supplied by the provider. You can safely import a newer or repeated export later.
sources.needArchiveBody: Follow a concise copy of the last verified official process. The instructions remain available without a network connection.
sources.guideTitle: How to obtain your Polar Flow export
sources.guideIntro: FitFreed documents the official acquisition path so the first step in owning your data does not depend on guesswork.

instructions.sign-in: Sign in on the official Polar account page in your default browser.
instructions.open-download-data: Open the Download your data area in the account menu.
instructions.request-export: Choose Download to ask Polar to prepare the export.
instructions.wait-for-email: Wait for Polar's email confirming that the archive is ready. Preparation time varies.
instructions.download-zip: Use the email link to download the ZIP, keep it unchanged, and return to FitFreed.

constraints.preparation-time-varies: Polar controls preparation and email delivery time; FitFreed cannot see its progress.
constraints.two-week-download-window: Polar says the prepared export remains available to download for two weeks.
constraints.derived-data-excluded: Polar says the export excludes some information derived by its services, including examples such as activity and sleep data. FitFreed can only use records present in the ZIP.

sources.troubleshootingHeading: If the archive does not arrive or import

troubleshooting.email-delivery: Check the address and spam folders associated with the provider account. Requesting or tracing the email remains a provider operation.
troubleshooting.expired-download: If the download window has expired, request a new export from the official account page.
troubleshooting.archive-format: Select the original ZIP. Do not extract, rename its internal files, or create a new ZIP before importing.

sources.externalNotice: Official pages open in your default browser. Their content and availability are controlled by the provider.
sources.providerBoundary: FitFreed never receives your credentials, signs in, requests the export, or downloads it for you.
sources.guideUnavailable: The guide for this source is unavailable. FitFreed will not guess provider instructions.

outcome.heading: Latest import outcome
outcome.changedHeading: Your local history has been updated
outcome.changedConsequence: The archive added or improved information that is now usable in your library.
outcome.reviewedConsequence: The archive was processed successfully, but it did not change your current library.
outcome.repeatHeading: This archive is already accounted for
outcome.repeatConsequence: Nothing was duplicated. If support for the source evolves, a later FitFreed mapping can reassess the same ZIP.
outcome.rejectedConsequence: Your existing library was not changed. Choose another ZIP or inspect the exact reason and coverage.
outcome.failedHeading: The import could not be completed
outcome.failedConsequence: Your existing library was not changed. You can retry or inspect the exact reason before choosing another ZIP.
outcome.cancelledConsequence: Your existing library was not changed. You can leave safely or choose a ZIP when you are ready.
outcome.coverageComplete: Every file in the ZIP was classified.
outcome.coverageIncomplete: Coverage is incomplete because processing stopped before every file in the ZIP was classified.

mapped.reason: The data is mapped into the current library.

mapped-training-evidence.reason: Session summaries, exercise structure, laps, pauses, recorded routes, supported time-series signals, and supported recorded zones are mapped; unsupported zone groups and signal types stay only in the original ZIP.
mapped-training-evidence.action: Keep the original ZIP if you need unsupported zone groups or signal types.

mapped-sleep-periods.reason: Sleep periods, phases, and interruptions are mapped; alarm behavior and source-only metadata stay only in the original ZIP.
mapped-sleep-periods.action: Keep the original ZIP if you need the excluded sleep details.

mapped-sleep-scores.reason: Sleep score components are mapped; scoring baselines stay only in the original ZIP.
mapped-sleep-scores.action: Keep the original ZIP if you need the excluded scoring context.

mapped-recovery-summaries.reason: Dated recovery summaries and their available assessment, baseline, and guidance are mapped into the library.
mapped-recovery-summaries.action: No action is needed for the dated summaries.

excluded-unidentifiable-recovery-samples.reason: Recovery samples have no documented date or record identity, so FitFreed cannot join them safely.
excluded-unidentifiable-recovery-samples.action: Keep the original ZIP if you need the excluded recovery samples.

source-subject-claim.reason: The data is used only to link packages from the same provider account.

known-family-not-yet-supported.reason: The data family is recognized but is not imported by this version.
known-family-not-yet-supported.action: Keep the original ZIP for a future version.

mvp-excludes-sensitive-profile.reason: Sensitive profile details are intentionally excluded from the MVP.
mvp-excludes-sensitive-profile.action: Keep the original ZIP if these details matter to you.

mvp-excludes-profile-picture.reason: Profile pictures are intentionally excluded from the MVP.
mvp-excludes-profile-picture.action: Keep the original ZIP if the picture matters to you.

mvp-excludes-full-resolution-physiology.reason: Full-resolution physiological samples are intentionally excluded from the MVP.
mvp-excludes-full-resolution-physiology.action: Keep the original ZIP for a future specialist import.

unrecognized-artifact-family.reason: The file does not match a known data family.
unrecognized-artifact-family.action: Keep the original ZIP and report the compatibility problem.

invalid-supported-artifact.action: Keep the original ZIP and report the compatibility problem.

filename-content-date-mismatch.reason: The filename date and the date inside the activity record disagree.
filename-content-date-mismatch.action: Keep the original ZIP and report the compatibility problem.

duplicate-daily-activity-date.reason: The package contains more than one daily activity record for the same date.
duplicate-daily-activity-date.action: Request a new export or report the compatibility problem.

filename-content-start-mismatch.reason: The training-session filename time and the session start time disagree.
filename-content-start-mismatch.action: Keep the original ZIP and report the compatibility problem.

duplicate-training-session-id.reason: The package contains more than one training session with the same source identity.
duplicate-training-session-id.action: Request a new export or report the compatibility problem.

duplicate-sleep-result-date.reason: The package contains more than one sleep result for the same source-assigned date.
duplicate-sleep-result-date.action: Request a new export or report the compatibility problem.

duplicate-sleep-score-date.reason: The package contains more than one sleep score for the same source-assigned date.
duplicate-sleep-score-date.action: Request a new export or report the compatibility problem.

orphan-sleep-score-date.reason: The package contains a sleep score without its corresponding sleep result.
orphan-sleep-score-date.action: Use the original complete export ZIP or report the compatibility problem.

duplicate-nightly-recovery-date.reason: The package contains more than one recovery summary for the same source-assigned date.
duplicate-nightly-recovery-date.action: Request a new export or report the compatibility problem.

invalid-source-subject-evidence.reason: The provider account evidence could not be validated.
invalid-source-subject-evidence.action: Use the original complete export ZIP or report the compatibility problem.

unknown.reason: This version has no localized explanation for the recorded reason.
unknown.action: Keep the original ZIP and report the compatibility problem.

reports.heading: Create and export reports
reports.intro: Saved reports open as results. Create one from a training session or comparison, review its evidence, and export a self-contained HTML file when you choose.
reports.empty: No reports have been saved yet.

library.omittedSourceOne: {count} additional source is available in the report.
library.omittedSourceMany: {count} additional sources are available in the report.
library.resultUnavailable: The saved evidence is not available in the current library.
library.authoredOnlyResult: This report contains authored content without imported evidence.
library.locationIncluded: Recorded location · {count} routes without endpoint privacy
library.locationPrivacyMany: Recorded location · {count} routes · at least {meters} m endpoint privacy

reports.chooseHeading: What do you want to understand or explain?
reports.chooseBody: Start a comparison here, or create a report from the session or comparison you are already exploring so its evidence is selected for you.
reports.resolving: Resolving the report against the current library…
reports.questionDefaultTitle: How has my recent training changed?
reports.blocksIntro: Order the evidence and optional commentary as you want them to appear in the saved report and export.
reports.narrativeHelp: Optional text written by you. It remains visibly separate from recorded and calculated evidence.
reports.narrativeRequiredHelp: This older authored-only report needs commentary until supported evidence is added.

commentary.heading: Optional commentary
commentary.intro: The evidence can stand on its own. Add your own words only when they help explain the result.

reports.includeHeartRateHelp: Adds average and maximum heart rate when the source recorded them.
reports.heartRateUnavailable: This session has no recorded heart-rate summary.
reports.endpointRedactionHelp: FitFreed removes at least this recorded distance independently from the start and finish. The saved default is 200 m.
reports.zeroRedactionWarning: Zero removes no distance from the recorded start or finish. Use it only when revealing both route endpoints through the shape is safe.
reports.addRouteIntro: Routes stay local. Adding one stores only its opaque reference and your endpoint-redaction choice.
reports.routesLoading: Finding routes recorded for this session…
reports.routesFailed: Routes could not be resolved from this library snapshot. Existing report content is unchanged.
reports.noRoutes: This session has no route evidence available for a report.
reports.allRoutesAdded: Every available route is already in this report.

analysis.addHeading: Add an answer from your training history
analysis.addIntro: Choose the evidence views that answer your question. Every selected view uses one shared, versioned comparison so the finding, chart, table, and coverage cannot silently disagree.
analysis.periodsHelp: Both periods are inclusive and may contain up to 366 days. FitFreed reads them again from the current local library whenever the report is opened or exported.
analysis.allAdded: All available comparison views are in this report.
analysis.rangeAttribution: Calculated by FitFreed from {baseline} and {comparison} in the current local library.
analysis.descriptiveOnly: This is a descriptive comparison of recorded data. It does not establish a cause or provide health or training advice.
analysis.unavailable: The comparison evidence is not available from the current local library.
analysis.chartSummary: Baseline and comparison bars with exact values in the table below

training-finding.heading: Key finding
training-finding.description: Lead with one exact, plain-language change selected by you.

training-comparison.heading: Period comparison
training-comparison.description: Compare the core training volume measures side by side.

training-chart.heading: Comparison chart
training-chart.description: Make one selected measure visual while retaining an exact table alternative.

training-exact-table.heading: Exact values
training-exact-table.description: Include all supported measures without visual rounding.

training-coverage.heading: Coverage and missing data
training-coverage.description: Show how much evidence supports each period and where measurements are absent.

reports.saved: Report saved in your local library.
reports.stale: The training library changed after this definition was saved. The preview shows the current candidate, while editing and export remain locked until you review the change.

refresh.heading: Review the current library evidence
refresh.intro: The complete report preview above has been recalculated from the current local library. Nothing changes unless you confirm this exact candidate.
refresh.savedBody: The report still points to the library revision you previously reviewed.
refresh.candidateBody: The preview above uses the latest compatible evidence available in this local library.
refresh.historicalBoundary: FitFreed does not retain historical copies of canonical data, so it cannot reconstruct or invent old numeric values for a before-and-after comparison.

preserved.authorship: Report title, optional commentary, and language
preserved.origin: Report origin and selected comparison periods
preserved.composition: Block identity, order, measurements, and privacy choices

updated.evidence: Recorded and calculated evidence in the preview
updated.context: Evidence attribution, coverage, and missing-data notices
updated.revision: The reviewed library reference and report revision

refresh.confirmation: Confirm only if the candidate preview represents the evidence you want this report to use. Importing data never performs this action automatically.
refresh.completed: The report now uses the evidence revision you reviewed. Authored content and composition were preserved.

reports.recordedAttribution: Recorded evidence from the local fitness library
reports.locationAttribution: Recorded location evidence with endpoint privacy applied by FitFreed
reports.routeOmitted: Route geometry is omitted by the current privacy choice.
reports.routeFullyRedacted: No recorded point remains after endpoint redaction.
reports.routeEvidenceUnavailable: This route cannot be resolved from the current library.
reports.routeVisualSummary: {kind}, local shape from {count} recorded points after endpoint redaction.
reports.noLimitations: All measurements selected by this definition are available.

limitations.distance-unavailable: Distance was not recorded for this session.
limitations.energy-unavailable: Energy was not recorded for this session.
limitations.heart-rate-unavailable: Heart-rate summary was selected but is unavailable.
limitations.sport-unclassified: The recorded sport has not been classified yet.
limitations.sport-unavailable: The source did not record a sport.

reports.librarySnapshotProvenance: Calculated from the identified revision of the local training library
reports.authoredOnlyProvenance: User-authored content; no imported evidence selected
reports.privacyIntro: This is the complete content boundary for the HTML file. Nothing else from your library will be exported.
reports.sessionSummaryIncluded: Recorded session summary and explicit missing-data notices
reports.analysisExportIncluded: Selected period-comparison values, findings, chart shapes, exact tables, and coverage notices
reports.exactSamplesExcluded: Exact training samples are excluded. Selected routes use only the reviewed local shape below.
reports.exportHeartRate: Include heart-rate summary in this export
reports.exportHeartRateHelp: You can remove physiological data from this individual export without changing the saved definition.
reports.exportHeartRateNotAllowed: The saved definition does not permit physiological data in the export.
reports.routeReviewIntro: Review every route independently. You can omit its geometry or increase endpoint redaction without changing the saved report.
reports.exportRouteHelp: The HTML receives a normalized local SVG shape, never recorded latitude or longitude values.
reports.localOutput: The HTML file is written only to the location you choose on this device.

delete.heading: Remove {title}?
delete.intro: This removes the saved report definition from this local library.
delete.boundary: Imported history and other reports stay unchanged. This report cannot be recovered after confirmation.
delete.removed: {title} was removed. Imported history was not changed.

errors.invalid-report-definition: Add a title and keep supported evidence or commentary before saving the report.
errors.invalid-report-comparison-range: Choose real, ordered dates of no more than 366 days for both comparison periods.
errors.report-not-found: That report no longer exists in the local library. Reload the list.
errors.report-definition-conflict: This report changed while it was open. Reload it before saving again.
errors.report-source-changed: The source history changed after this report was resolved. Reopen the report before exporting.
errors.report-evidence-unavailable: The evidence needed by this report is not available in the local library.
errors.report-definition-query-failed: FitFreed could not read saved reports. Your library is unchanged; try reloading.
errors.report-definition-update-failed: FitFreed could not save the report. The previous definition is unchanged.
errors.report-export-cancelled: The export was cancelled. No partial file was left behind.
errors.report-export-failed: FitFreed could not write the complete report. Choose another local destination and try again.
errors.unexpected: FitFreed encountered an unexpected local report error. Reopen the report before trying again.

settings.title: Application settings
settings.intro: Choose how FitFreed is displayed and maintained on this device. These settings do not change your imported history.
settings.appearanceIntro: Preview language, appearance, and content size. Nothing is stored until you save.
settings.languageBody: Changes application navigation and explanatory text. Names you created remain unchanged.
settings.appearanceBody: System follows the appearance selected for the operating system.
settings.zoomBody: Scales text, controls, charts, and exact-value tables together.
settings.previewBody: This example uses the language, appearance, and content size currently selected.
settings.localOnly: These preferences stay on this device. They do not modify or leave with your fitness history.
settings.recovered: FitFreed restored safe application defaults because the stored settings were not compatible with this version. Review and save them if needed.

updates.heading: Application updates
updates.intro: FitFreed validates signed release information before announcing an update.
updates.installNotice: FitFreed preserves the current application and library before replacing the application. It then restarts and verifies the update automatically.

recovery.updated: FitFreed updated from version {sourceVersion} to {targetVersion}. The installed application and local library were verified before the previous recovery copy was removed.
recovery.recovered: FitFreed automatically restored version {sourceVersion} after the update to version {targetVersion} did not complete. The restored application and local library were verified.

statuses.unconfigured: Update checks are not configured in this development build.
statuses.offline: Update information is temporarily unavailable. Your local library is unaffected.
statuses.dismissed: This version will no longer be announced automatically.
statuses.postponed: The update reminder is postponed until {until}.
statuses.withdrawnInstalled: Installed version {installedVersion} has been withdrawn because of a {reason} risk.
statuses.manualRecoveryRequired: This update needs a manual recovery path: {reason}.
statuses.untrusted: Update information could not be trusted and was ignored. Your local library is unaffected.

manualRecoveryReasons.installed-version-unsupported: the installed version is no longer supported by the safe update path
manualRecoveryReasons.library-schema-unsupported: the local library schema is outside the release's supported range
manualRecoveryReasons.no-safe-replacement: the channel does not currently provide a safe replacement

trustFailures.response-too-large: The response exceeded the safety limit.
trustFailures.unknown-key: The signing key is not trusted by this build.
trustFailures.mirror-mismatch: The mirrored release metadata did not match.
trustFailures.missing-target: The release has no package for this platform.
trustFailures.unsupported-channel: The release channel version is unsupported.
trustFailures.invalid-validity-window: The release validity period was invalid.
trustFailures.expired: The signed release information had expired.
trustFailures.downgrade: A release older than the installed version was rejected.

errors.invalid-supported-artifact: This package contains recognized data that FitFreed cannot validate. Keep the original ZIP and report the compatibility problem; no history was changed.
errors.invalid-source-subject-evidence: FitFreed cannot establish which provider account this package belongs to. Choose the original complete export ZIP; no history was changed.
errors.source-subject-confirmation-required: This package has different or changed account evidence. FitFreed will not merge it with the existing history automatically. Keep the ZIP until account separation and recovery are available; existing history was preserved.
errors.invalid-library-correlation-state: FitFreed cannot verify this library's account-correlation state. Do not import again until the library has been preserved and the problem has been investigated.
errors.invalid-zip-container: This is not a supported ZIP container. Choose the original export ZIP without repacking it.
errors.unsafe-archive-member: The package contains an unsafe file layout. Keep the original ZIP and report the compatibility problem; FitFreed did not extract it.
errors.duplicate-archive-member: The package contains duplicate file names and cannot be imported safely. Request a new export or report the compatibility problem.
errors.archive-resource-limit: The package exceeds a safety limit. Keep the original ZIP and report its approximate size so compatibility can be assessed safely.
errors.archive-io-failure: FitFreed could not read the ZIP. Move it to a local readable folder and try again.
errors.database-failure: FitFreed could not update the local library. Restart the application and retry; if it fails again, preserve the library before reporting the problem.
errors.interrupted: The previous import was interrupted and rolled back. Retry the original ZIP; existing history was preserved.
errors.import-already-active: Another import is already active. Cancel it or wait for it to finish before retrying.
errors.import-coordination-failed: FitFreed could not coordinate the import. Restart the application before retrying.
errors.library-unavailable: The local library is unavailable. Restart FitFreed; if the problem persists, preserve the application data before reporting it.
errors.library-query-failed: FitFreed could not read fitness history. Restart the application and try again.
errors.invalid-activity-range: Choose an ordered range inside the available history, up to 366 days.
errors.invalid-activity-comparison: Choose ordered comparison periods inside the available history, up to 366 days each.
errors.invalid-training-range: Choose an ordered training range inside the available history, up to 366 days.
errors.invalid-training-comparison: Choose ordered training comparison periods inside the available history, up to 366 days each.
errors.invalid-training-session-search: Choose an ordered training-session date range and a personal sport name of up to 80 characters.
errors.training-session-search-changed: Your training library changed. Refresh the search and continue from the first page.
errors.training-session-search-failed: FitFreed could not search training sessions. Your history is unchanged; restart the application and try again.
errors.invalid-sport-classification: Choose a supported broad family, enter a sport name of up to 80 characters, or return the sport to unknown.
errors.sport-classification-conflict: This sport classification changed while it was open. Review the current value and try again.
errors.sport-classification-failed: FitFreed could not read or save sport classifications. Your training history and previous classifications are unchanged.
errors.invalid-sleep-range: Choose an ordered sleep range inside the available history, up to 366 nights.
errors.invalid-sleep-comparison: Choose ordered sleep comparison periods inside the available history, up to 366 nights each.
errors.invalid-sleep-reference: That sleep detail is no longer available. Refresh the period and choose the night again.
errors.invalid-recovery-range: Choose an ordered recovery range inside the available history, up to 366 nights.
errors.invalid-recovery-comparison: Choose ordered recovery comparison periods inside the available history, up to 366 nights each.
errors.invalid-recovery-reference: That recovery detail is no longer available. Refresh the period and choose the night again.
errors.invalid-longitudinal-range: Choose an ordered shared period inside the complete available history, up to 366 dates.
errors.invalid-longitudinal-comparison: Choose ordered shared comparison periods inside the complete available history, up to 366 dates each.
errors.invalid-library-home-request: FitFreed could not open that library view because its context was invalid. Return to Home and try again.
errors.invalid-exploration-workspace: That exploration is no longer supported by the current library. Return to Home and choose an available question.
errors.exploration-workspace-query-failed: FitFreed could not restore the previous exploration. Your history is unchanged; return to Home and choose a question again.
errors.exploration-workspace-update-failed: FitFreed could not save the exploration safely. Your history is unchanged; try the question again.
errors.outcome-query-failed: FitFreed could not read the latest import outcome. Restart the application and verify the library before importing again.
errors.source-guide-query-failed: FitFreed could not load the bundled source guide. Restart the application; FitFreed will not guess provider instructions.
errors.official-source-link-failed: FitFreed could not open the official page. The offline instructions remain available; open the provider page directly in your browser if needed.
errors.archive-picker-failed: FitFreed could not open the ZIP chooser. Try again; no history was changed.
errors.preference-query-failed: FitFreed could not read the saved application settings. Safe defaults are being used for now; restart the application before changing them.
errors.preference-initialization-failed: FitFreed could not save the initial application settings. Safe defaults will be used for this session; restart the application to try again.
errors.preference-update-failed: FitFreed could not save the application settings. The previous settings have been restored; restart the application before trying again.
errors.invalid-preference-version: These settings belong to an unsupported application version. Restore the defaults before saving them.
errors.invalid-locale: That language is not supported by this FitFreed version. Choose English (US) or Spanish (Spain).
errors.invalid-appearance: That appearance is not supported. Choose System, Light, or Dark.
errors.invalid-content-zoom: Choose a content zoom from 100% through 200%.
errors.desktop-task-failed: A desktop task stopped unexpectedly. Restart FitFreed before retrying the previous action.
errors.desktop-operation-active: FitFreed cannot install an update while another import or update is active. Wait for it to finish, then try again.
errors.desktop-operation-coordination-failed: FitFreed could not reserve the application for this update. Restart FitFreed before trying again.
errors.import-failed: The import could not be completed. Retry once; if it fails again, keep the original ZIP and report the problem.
errors.update-channel-failed: FitFreed could not complete the update check. Your local library was not changed; try again later.
errors.update-state-unavailable: FitFreed could not read or save the local update state. Preserve the application data and restart before retrying.
errors.update-candidate-changed: The available update changed before the preference was saved. Check again before choosing an action.
errors.invalid-update-preference: The update preference was rejected because its version or time was invalid. Check again before choosing an action.
errors.update-installation-not-allowed: This release is not authorized for in-app installation. Check again and follow the displayed recovery guidance.
errors.update-installation-unavailable: FitFreed cannot safely locate the installed application. Install the update manually or move FitFreed into Applications before trying again.
errors.update-package-trust-unavailable: FitFreed could not load the trusted update key. The package was not downloaded or installed.
errors.update-package-authorization-invalid: The update authorization is no longer valid. Check for updates again before installing.
errors.update-native-installer-failed: FitFreed could not install the verified update. Automatic recovery is protecting the current application and library; reopen FitFreed if it does not restart.
errors.update-download-unavailable: FitFreed could not download the update package. The current application and library were not changed; try again later.
errors.update-package-untrusted: The downloaded update package did not match its signed release information and was rejected. The current application and library were not changed.
errors.update-watchdog-failed: FitFreed could not start the independent update recovery monitor. The current application was not replaced; restart before trying again.
errors.update-recovery-failed: FitFreed could not prepare or advance safe update recovery. Preserve the application data and reinstall manually before retrying.
errors.update-recovery-confirmation-failed: FitFreed could not confirm the updated application and library. Keep the application open while automatic recovery completes.
errors.update-recovery-outcome-failed: FitFreed could not finish or acknowledge update recovery safely. Preserve the application data and restart before trying another update.
errors.invalid-report-definition: The report definition is not valid. Review its title, interpretation, and source session.
errors.report-not-found: That report no longer exists in the local library. Reload the report list.
errors.report-definition-conflict: This report changed while it was open. Reload it before saving again.
errors.report-source-changed: The source history changed after this report was resolved. Reopen it before exporting.
errors.report-evidence-unavailable: The session used by this report is no longer available in the local library.
errors.report-definition-query-failed: FitFreed could not read saved reports. Your library is unchanged; try reloading.
errors.report-definition-update-failed: FitFreed could not save the report. The previous definition is unchanged.
errors.report-export-cancelled: The report export was cancelled. No partial file was left behind.
errors.report-export-failed: FitFreed could not write the complete report. Choose another local destination and try again.
errors.report-export-active: Another report export is already active. Cancel it or wait for it to finish.
errors.report-export-state-unavailable: FitFreed could not coordinate the report export. Restart the application before trying again.
errors.unexpected: FitFreed encountered an unexpected local error. Restart the application before retrying.
